description: This source file implements process and error pipe handling for the Lighttpd server, including functions for creating, managing, and freeing error pipes and processes, with focus on process control, inter-process communication, and resource limits.

methods.name: void read_pipe(liServer * srv,liErrorPipe * epipe,gboolean flush)
methods.description: Reads data from a pipe, handling different conditions such as EOF, blocking, and errors, and invokes a callback with the data.

methods.name: void error_pipe_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback invoked when there's activity on the error pipe, calling read_pipe.

methods.name: liErrorPipe * li_error_pipe_new(liServer * srv,liErrorPipeCB cb,gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new error pipe structure with associated event watchers.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_free(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with an error pipe, including event watchers and memory.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_activate(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Activates the error pipe to start processing by closing the out-fd and starting event watcher.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_use(liErrorPipe * epipe,int dest_fd)
methods.description: Uses the error pipe to redirect the out-fd to a specified destination fd.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_flush(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Flushes the error pipe by reading all available data.

methods.name: void proc_epipe_cb(liServer * srv,liErrorPipe * epipe,GString * msg)
methods.description: Callback to handle error messages from the error pipe, logging with process info.

methods.name: liProc * li_proc_new(liServer * srv,gchar ** args,gchar ** env,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gchar * username,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile,liProcSetupCB cb,gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Creates a new process, sets resource limits, changes user/group if needed, and executes the given command.

methods.name: void li_proc_free(liProc * proc)
methods.description: Frees the process structure and associated error pipe.

ctags.name: li_proc_new
